title: 'Maybank dan UMSKAL perkasa generasi pelajar Labuan ke arah masa depan pendidikan yang cemerlang
body: 'Nor Rashidi (tengah), Profesor Dr. Shamsul Bahari (dua kanan), Imbran (kiri) dan Nur Iman (kanan) bergambar kenangan bersama pelajar yang menjayakan Program Maybank Global CR Day 2026: “Cahaya Future Ready” LABUAN: Maybank International Labuan Branch dengan kerjasama Bahagian Hal Ehwal Pelajar UMSKAL telah menganjurkan Program Maybank Global CR Day 2026 yang diadakan di Dewan Theatrette, Universiti Malaysia Sabah Kampus Antarabangsa Labuan (UMSKAL) pada Sabtu.

title: 'Weekly Strategy - 5 Oct 2026
body: 'The FBM KLCI came under significant selling pressure last week, falling to a 42-week low of 1,630 and marking a fresh 2026 low amid persistent foreign fund outflows. Investor sentiment was further weighed down by rising U.S. Treasury yields and concerns over higher borrowing costs, while heightened geopolitical uncertainty surrounding the U.S.-Iran conflict raised concerns over its potential inflationary impact. Although bargain hunting provided intermittent support following the sharp sell-off, recovery attempts lacked momentum and proved short-lived amid continued caution.
